image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a printed restaurant menu lying on a white tablecloth. The menu features a large photo of a dish (likely braised meatballs or similar) at the top, followed by sections with smaller food photos and text descriptions in Chinese characters with some English translations. Prices are listed in red. A green bottle is partially visible in the top right corner, and chopsticks/restware are blurred in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Folded card, booklet, or single sheet with structured typography.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly a single sheet or open page of a menu with distinct typographic hierarchy (headings, body text, prices).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Clear hierarchical headings with consistent font styling.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Headings are larger and bolder; body text is smaller. Font consistency appears maintained across sections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Occasional decorative borders or restaurant branding elements.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No explicit decorative borders or logos are clearly visible; the design relies on whitespace and color blocks rather than ornamental borders.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Food and beverage items organized by category (appetizers, entrees, desserts).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Items are grouped under headings with accompanying images, suggesting categorical organization typical of menus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Item names, descriptions, and prices listed systematically.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Each item has a name, descriptive text, and a price in red, aligned consistently.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Layout reflects restaurant theme and ambiance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ambiance/theme cannot be objectively verified from the menu alone without external context; this is subjective and not visually testable as a structural feature.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Paper stock ranges from thin cardstock to laminated durable material.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Material texture and lamination cannot be definitively determined from a 2D image; surface reflectivity is ambiguous due to lighting.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Color scheme coordinated with restaurant branding.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Branding coordination requires knowledge of the restaurant’s identity; color scheme exists but its alignment with branding is untestable.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Printed or digital listing of available dining options.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Clearly a printed physical document with ink-on-paper appearance, no screen glare or pixelation indicative of digital display.

artifact_observations.location: Main body text blocks, especially under the top dish image and in lower sections
artifact_observations.reasoning: Chinese characters appear malformed or nonsensical upon close inspection — strokes are inconsistent, some characters blend into each other, and spacing is irregular. This is a common AI artifact when generating non-Latin scripts. English text also shows slight kerning anomalies.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of the menu paper, particularly around the edges of food images
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight smudging or bleeding between the printed food photos and the white background, suggesting imperfect edge definition. Not severe, but noticeable on close inspection.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom edge of the menu and tablecloth interface
artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom edge of the menu does not align perfectly with the perspective of the tablecloth; slight warping suggests minor geometric inconsistency in depth rendering.

selected_experts.reason: Primary class verification: confirm the object is indeed a menu and not a poster, flyer, or book page.
Critical for auditing legibility and correctness of generated text, especially given observed gibberish in Chinese characters.
Verify clean boundaries between menu content and background, and ensure food images are properly contained without bleeding.
Holistic assessment of print quality, shadow consistency, and material realism.
Assess if the menu lies flat on the table with correct perspective and contact shadows.

focus_areas: Text legibility and character integrity (especially CJK script)
Edge sharpness between menu content and background
Perspective consistency of menu relative to table surface
Realism of printed material texture and lighting response
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to the text auditor's output — if Chinese characters are confirmed as gibberish, this is a critical failure for a menu. Also verify whether the 'texture_anomaly' noted by the Router is actually a printing artifact or an AI generation flaw. The geometric_depth_auditor should confirm if the menu’s angle matches the table’s plane.
